title: Bible Verse for When You Ignore the Warning | Psalm 19:11 KJV
caption: God's Word warns you before the trouble, not after. Psalm 19:11 KJV: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward. A warning isn't God being hard on you; it's God keeping your hand whole. Today, read the warning before you touch the machine. Follow Blessed Prayers so the Word finds you on the hard days, and drop an amen. Derrick Hughes is an AI-generated presenter. The Word is real. #MorningPrayer #BibleVerse #Psalm19 #KJV #BlessedPrayers
